name: MyriFetch v1.4.1: The Auto-CHD Update
body:
### ✨ New Features & Integrations

* **Automated CHD Compression:** Seamless CHDman integration has arrived. MyriFetch can now automatically extract and compress ISO/BIN/CUE downloads into CHD format for supported systems (PS1, PS2, PSP, and Dreamcast) immediately after the download finishes, saving massive amounts of storage space.
* **Subfolder Extraction Cleanup:** When CHD compression successfully finishes, the app now automatically cleans up the leftover extracted folders to keep your directories tidy.

### 🛠 Upcoming

* **Bug Fixes:** I am aware of a few lingering bugs! Things have been keeping me pretty busy recently so I haven't had much time, but I will be jumping back in to work on squashing those soon.

### 🤝 Credits

* A massive thank you to [AdamFinke07](https://github.com/AdamFinke07) for the pull request that brought the automated CHD compression feature to life!

name: MyriFetch v1.4.0: The Achievements & Accessibility Update
body:
#### Core Logic & Performance Improvements

* **Master Staging Queue**: Restructured the bulk downloader to use a secondary staging system.
* **Batch Processing**: Large download jobs are now processed in groups of 100 rather than flooding the active queue all at once.
* **Memory Optimization**: Implemented O(1) dictionary lookups for file metadata to prevent UI lag during massive library scans.
* **Stability Fix**: Resolved a critical crash that occurred when attempting to "Download All" on console directories with thousands of files.

#### Download Features

* **Real-time Selection Counter**: The "Download Selected" button now displays the exact number of items currently checked.
* **Improved Bulk Downloader**: The "Download All Listed" feature now correctly queues every file across all pages in your current filtered view.
* **Smart Pallet Clearing**: Clicking "Stop Download" now fully wipes both the active download list and the pending staging queue to prevent leftover files from starting later.

#### New Settings & UI

* **RetroAchievements Integration**: Added a dedicated sidebar tab to view your profile stats, points, and rank directly in the app.
* **Direct RA Library Access**: Added a "Browse RA-Supported ROMs" button to jump straight to the RetroAchievements game directory on Myrient.
* **Scalable UI Text**: Added a "Browser Text Size" slider in the settings to let you resize the game list text for better readability.
* **Notification Toggle**: Added a setting to turn the download finish chime on or off.
* **Advanced Filtering**: Added toggles to automatically hide Demos and Revisions from your search results.
* **Batch Tracking**: Added UI indicators to the download tab showing "Total Left" and "Batches Left" for large jobs.

#### Bug Fixes

* **API Domain Correction**: Fixed a connection issue by updating the RetroAchievements API endpoint to the correct domain.
* **Syntax Error Cleanup**: Fixed a crash caused by improper character escaping in the BIOS and Achievements menus.

name: MyriFetch v1.3.1: The Connectivity Update
body:
#### **🚀 New Features**

* **Version Display**: The sidebar status indicator has been updated to show the current application version (`v1.3.1`) instead of a generic "Online" status.
* **Update Tracking**: Added a new **"Check for Updates ↗"** button in the sidebar that links directly to the project's GitHub repository for easier access to new releases.

#### **🛠 Improvements & Bug Fixes**

* **Linux Stability**: This update includes potential fixes for the crashes recently reported on Linux distributions.

name: MyriFetch v1.3.0: The "Visual Library" & Stability Update
body:
Changelog:

✨ New Features: Visual Library & Metadata

    Game Library: Added a new "Library" tab that displays your downloaded games in a grid view with high-quality box art.

    Game Details Page: Clicking a game in the Library now opens a dedicated details view showing the description, release date, genre, and developer.

    Live Tooltips: Hovering over a file in the browser now fetches and displays live game metadata (Release Date, Genre, Dev) from IGDB.

    Twitch/IGDB Integration: Added full API integration to fetch metadata and cover art. (Includes a built-in guide in Settings on how to get your free API keys).

📂 Smart Organization

    Auto-Subfolders: Downloads are now can be organized into console-specific subfolders (e.g., /PS2/) and game-specific folders (e.g., /PS2/God of War/).

    Cover Art Saving: Box art is automatically downloaded and saved alongside the game ISO/ROM.

    Context Aware Saving: If you select a manual download folder, the app now intelligently asks if you want to save that location as the default for that console.

🔧 Critical Fixes & Stability

    Redump Download Fix: Fixed an issue where large Redump files (1GB+) would fail or corrupt. The engine now detects file size issues and switches to a robust stream mode to guarantee download completion.

    Long Path Support: Fixed "Silent Crashes" on Windows caused by long filenames (common with Redump ISOs).

    Permission Handling: Added better error logging and checks to prevent crashes when writing to protected folders.

⚙️ Settings & UI

    Reorganized the Settings menu for better readability.

    Added a "Clear All Saved Directories" button.

    Added "Open File Location" and "Delete Game" buttons to the Game Details view.

Added a MacOS build but I don't have a way to test it

name: MyriFetch v1.2.0 - The BIOS & Management Update
body:
This update introduces major new functionality for emulation setup, collection management, and a complete overhaul of the user interface.

🚀 New Features

🧬 BIOS Manager

Dedicated BIOS Tab: Added a new sidebar menu for downloading essential system files.

One-Click RetroArch Pack: Integrated a direct downloader for the complete system.7z BIOS pack from Archive.org.

Setup Instructions: Added built-in guides for setting up BIOS files with popular emulators (DuckStation, PCSX2, Flycast, etc.).

📂 Collection Management

Ownership Filters: Added a dropdown to filter the file list. You can now choose to see "Missing Only", "Owned Only", or "All".

⬇ "Download All" Button: Added a button to bulk-queue every item currently visible in the list.

Pro Tip: Combine this with the "Missing Only" filter to download an entire missing collection in one click.

🎨 Custom UI Overhaul

New Theme (Gruvbox): Replaced the Dracula theme with Gruvbox, a warmer, retro-terminal aesthetic perfect for late-night archiving.

Themed File Browser: Replaced the standard (and often jarring) operating system file dialogs with a fully custom, theme-aware File Manager.

Custom Themed Popups: Replaced default system message boxes with custom, dark-mode popups that match your selected theme.

⚡ Core Improvements

Smart Download Engine: The "Hydra" engine now automatically detects files with unknown sizes (like dynamic Archive.org streams) and intelligently switches to a robust single-threaded mode to prevent corruption.

Connection Stability: Fixed "Remote end closed connection" errors when downloading from non-Myrient sources by sanitizing HTTP headers.

Scroll Fixes: Fixed mouse wheel scrolling issues in the new file manager and settings menus.

📥 Download

Windows: MyriFetch.exe

Linux: MyriFetch-x86_64.AppImage

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/CrabbieMike/MyriFetch/compare/v1.1.0...v1.2.0

name: MyriFetch v1.1.0 - The "Quality of Life" Update
body:
✨ New Features

📦 Collection Management

"Already Owned" Indicators: Files you already have in your folder will now appear Green with a ✔ Checkmark. No more accidental duplicate downloads!

Queue Manager: Added a "Pending Queue" list in the Downloads tab. You can now see exactly what's waiting and click ❌ to remove specific items before they start.

Disk Space Visualizer: Added a storage bar that shows how much free space is left on your drive (Green/Orange/Red status).

"Open Folder" Button: Added a quick button to open your current download folder in Explorer/Finder/Nautilus.

🎨 UI & Customization

New Themes: Added 3 new themes in Settings: Dracula, Matrix, and Nord.

Region Filtering: Added a dropdown to filter lists by region (USA, Europe, Japan, etc.). You can set a Default Region in settings to auto-apply this on startup.

Organized Quick Jump: Consoles are now grouped by manufacturer (Sony, Nintendo, Sega, etc.) and sorted by release order.

UI Polish: Added "bubble" styling to search bars and dropdowns for better visibility.

🐛 Bug Fixes & Improvements

Stability: Fixed the "invalid command name" crash by properly moving UI updates to the main thread (threading safety).

Performance: The Search bar now triggers on Enter keypress instead of every keystroke, eliminating lag on large file lists.

Crash Handler: Added a global error catcher that displays a popup with details if the app crashes on startup, instead of silently closing.

PS3 Support: Added PlayStation 3 to the Quick Jump menu.

📥 Download

Windows: MyriFetch.exe

Linux: MyriFetch-x86_64.AppImage

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/CrabbieMike/MyriFetch/compare/Release...v1.1.0
